title: A prompt the guard blocked never enters the cache
goal: For {{castBrand}}, {{castOwner}} must be sure a blocked prompt for {{castApp}} cannot come back from the cache later.
obstacle: If a blocked prompt were stored, a later ask could be served its answer.
control: In the lab the guard runs first: a blocked prompt is not looked up, sent, stored or counted. Whether the product runs the guard before or after the lookup is UNVERIFIED.
